item.title: Updating my website with Muse, only
item.description:
First time using Muse today — so I put it straight to work on this website.

Everything below the fold on the homepage is new: a live X feed that pulls my latest posts with no API key and no paid tier, my photo up top, the whole thing rebuilt and deployed from chat while I was on my phone. I just approved each step and watched it ship.

Honestly impressed. More experiments to come — this space is where I’ll write about them.
